title: Start an Animal Farm Together
outcome: Child builds a small fenced pen, lures and keeps at least two animals (cows/pigs/sheep/chickens), names them, and can explain what their animals need to stay put and be happy.
multiplayerRequirements: Shared-world variant on adult-owned Realm in peaceful difficulty; no hostile mob surprises.
knownIncompatibilities: Animal AI identical across Bedrock; peaceful mode required for age band

guardianSteps: Note for mentor if child is nervous about animals approaching
mentorPreflight: Wheat/seeds/carrots available in mentor helper inventory (child picks favorites)
Fence blocks pre-staged nearby but NOT placed

mentorMoves: Ask about their house or last build
Offer animal choices: cows, pigs, sheep, or chickens
Guide finding one animal nearby - celebrate first sighting!
Demonstrate holding wheat so an cow follows you
Ask 'What do you think happens when you hold the wheat?'
flow.childAction: Lures first animal toward pen area

mentorMoves: Help fence perimeter as child directs placement
Gather more fence blocks as runner
flow.childAction: Builds fence pen with gate, lures 2+ animals inside

mentorMoves: Offer name tags OR water trough (dig + water) OR color-choice via sheep
Screenshot with child standing inside pen among their animals
Record next: more animals? crops? expand?

openingLines: Ready to get some animals of your own?
Which animals do you want on your farm?
keyPhrases: Hold the wheat out - see how it follows you?
What should we name this one?

sharedRoles.childRole: Farmer - decides pen location, size, animal choices, names
sharedRoles.mentorRole: Farmhand - gathers materials, models lure once, helps with gate mechanics
sharedRoles.rotationNotes: Small groups: each child owns own pen; group may share one large pasture with separate sections

options: A name from a favorite show

commonProblems.fix: Normal learning moment! Ask 'what should we change?' - usually closing gates faster or double-gate design

commonProblems.problem: Can't find chosen animal type nearby
commonProblems.fix: Mentor walks WITH child toward biome where they spawn; or switch animal choice happily

commonProblems.problem: Child upset when animal won't follow
commonProblems.fix: Check they're holding (not just having) food; re-demo once; remind them animals are shy sometimes

hintLadder: Pick the wheat in your hand first - hold it up like showing them!
Stand close but walk backward slow...
See it following? Lead it right to your gate!
resetPath: Peaceful mode = animals never die from mobs. Escaped animals stay in world; mentor can help re-lure. If pen got griefed by accident (broken fences), rebuild together - it's fast.
soloFallback: Fully works solo-guided: same goals in single-player world with mentor narrating remotely.
accessibilityOptions: Mentor handles any part that frustrates on request while child keeps decision-making
Alternative: 'petting zoo' variant where animals come to a pre-built pen (mentor pre-builds)
safetyRequirements: Private world or adult-owned Realm; peaceful difficulty
No public servers; no unmanaged chat
parentSummaryTemplate: {child} started their own Minecraft farm today! They built a pen and got {count} animals ({names}) to live there. Ask what they named them!

review.notes: Needs playtest: confirm animal lure behavior matches description on Bedrock 1.21 current patch.

worldSpecification.description: BB Starter Plains variant switched to Peaceful survival; grassland area near spawn reserved for pens; starter chest contains wheat, seeds, carrots, fences, name tags.
